title: Runtime Target Policy document (D30 §1)
description: The deployment-owned document the Runtime plane reads from the reserved Tag provider. A Runtime Mutation fails closed with operation_disabled when it is missing, unreadable, over the product-enforced size cap, or does not satisfy this schema. `allowlists` is keyed by Tool name so a Tag target allowlist and an Alarm source allowlist cannot stand in for each other; an absent key means no target for that Tool, and `*` must be written explicitly (D08). This schema validates the document's shape only: the grammar of an entry (a provider-qualified Tag path prefix, or an Alarm source pattern) belongs to the Tool that reads that key, and a handler validates its own key strictly while the other keys are checked only as non-empty strings. Fields a Tool does not use are still shape-validated when present. A null-valued property is omitted, not set to null: the D28 wire encoding does not apply to this document's storage, and an explicit null is a malformed field. `tagWriteMaxWrites` and `alarmMaxPaths` are the deployment's raise of D10's 20-item project default; neither may pass the 100-item hard ceiling, and a Tool that finds one outside that range fails closed.
